params.name: f
params.description: The optional f parameter indicates the output format which the server shall provide as part of the response document.  The default format is GeoJSON.  CSV is also available.

params.name: lang
params.description: The optional lang parameter instructs the server return a response in a certain language, if supported.  If the language is not among the available values, the Accept-Language header language will be used if it is supported. If the header is missing, the default server language is used. Note that providers may only support a single language (or often no language at all), that can be different from the server language.  Language strings can be written in a complex (e.g. "fr-CA,fr;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7"), simple (e.g. "de") or locale-like (e.g. "de-CH" or "fr_BE") fashion.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Only features that have a geometry that intersects the bounding box are selected.The bounding box is provided as four or six numbers, depending on whether the coordinate reference system includes a vertical axis (height or depth).

params.name: limit
params.description: The optional limit parameter limits the number of items that are presented in the response document (maximum=50000, default=10000).

params.name: crs
params.description: Indicates the coordinate reference system for the results.

params.name: bbox-crs
params.description: Indicates the coordinate reference system for the given bbox coordinates.

params.name: properties
params.description: The properties that should be included. The parameter value is a comma-separated list of property names.

params.name: skipGeometry
params.description: This option can be used to skip response geometries for each feature.

params.name: offset
params.description: The optional offset parameter indicates the index within the result set from which the server shall begin presenting results in the response document.  The first element has an index of 0 (default).

params.name: id
params.description: Citation method identification number.

params.name: method_id
params.description: USGS Central Laboratory method code. The lab method used to determine a parameter value.

params.name: citation_name
params.description: Method citation name. An abbreviated citation that describes the reference.

params.name: citation_method_number
params.description: Citation method number. A number assigned to a method within a cited reference.

params.name: method_source
params.description: Protocol organization code.

params.name: filter
params.description:
CQL Text filter expression.  CQL JSON cannot be used here, only in the body. 
See also: https://docs.pygeoapi.io/en/latest/cql.html 

Example: time_series_id IN ('64ee32f5350a4ec4967435dcd2e364ea', '3e55d9c2d8a54bec9ca5e292b07d5a96')
